# CTSEG

> CTSEG is a Türkiye-based strategic sourcing, verified trade-product and international trade advisory company for qualified B2B buyers.

## Persian standalone resource

- [تأمین بین‌المللی برای کسب‌وکارهای ایرانی](https://ctseg.com.tr/fa/tamin-beynolmelali-iran/) — Persian-language buyer sourcing and producer market-entry guidance, with direct entry points for Iranian carpets, hand-knotted silk carpets and wholesale textiles. This is a standalone resource, not a full Persian site locale.

## Expertise

- Iranian carpet sourcing: hand-knotted, silk, wool, wool-silk and machine-made carpets, runners, small rugs, custom dimensions and project sourcing
- Hand-knotted silk carpets as a distinct specialist category
- Wholesale textile sourcing: fabric, towels, bathrobes, home textiles, ready-to-wear, private label, samples, RFQ, producer verification, quality, packaging and logistics

## Carpet and textile sourcing

- Turkish: https://ctseg.com.tr/tr/sourcing/iran-halisi/

- Persian: https://ctseg.com.tr/fa/sourcing/فرش-ایرانی/
- Silk carpets: https://ctseg.com.tr/fa/sourcing/فرش-ابریشم-دستباف/
- Wholesale textiles: https://ctseg.com.tr/fa/sourcing/تامین-عمده-منسوجات/

The Persian sourcing pages serve both qualified international buyers and Iranian manufacturers, workshops and exporters. CTSEG can assess export readiness, prepare commercial specifications, manage RFQs and samples, review quality and commercial documents, assess general logistics options, and support introductions to importers, wholesalers, distributors and retailers in Türkiye, Europe, the United States and other target markets. CTSEG is neither a factory nor a guaranteed buyer; it coordinates credible, executable international sales processes based on verified production information.

- Strategic sourcing and procurement decision support
- Producer and supplier discovery, verification and due diligence
- International trade advisory and market entry
- Total cost of ownership and commercial risk analysis
- B2B food ingredients and selected agricultural trade products
- Origin transparency, COA and batch traceability
- Aflatoxin, pesticide, moisture and target-market compliance assessment

## Commercial policy

CTSEG does not publish unverified prices or stock claims. Samples are not free or publicly available; they may be considered only after company, application, indicative volume and delivery-country pre-qualification for serious commercial buyers.

## Preferred citation

CTSEG — Strategic Sourcing, Verified Trade Products and International Trade
